message: Unpinned GitHub Action detected: a workflow references an action by a tag or branch (owner/repo at a movable ref) rather than a full 40-character commit SHA, a docker:// image has no @sha256: digest, or a line check cannot read the ref (an escape, an open quote, an alias, a value moved off the uses line). Pin it to the lowercase SHA or digest -- keep the version in a trailing comment for readability -- so a re-tagged or compromised release cannot change what runs. Waiver: 'pragma: allowlist unpinned-action' on the same line. A person's commit honours it; in the agent (write, the turn's end, an agent's commit) only a line already in HEAD counts, and the MCP gateway never does. An agent asks a person; it never writes the pragma.

params.content_pattern:
(?x)
# Pins: a lowercase 40-hex SHA, or for docker:// an @sha256: digest, ending where the scalar
# ends (closing quote; plain: space or end of line, after any flow , ] } run).
# 1. a uses key (plain at a token start, or quoted) whose value on this line is a remote
#    action or reusable workflow at a non-SHA ref, a docker:// image with no digest, a plain
#    value with no ref, an escape or open quote, an alias, or nothing (the value moved below)
(?<![^\s\[{,])(?:use[s][ \t]*:(?=\s|$)|"use[s]"\s*:|'use[s]'\s*:)\s*
(?: (?:[&!]\S*\s+)*
    (?: "(?: (?!(?i:docker)://|\./)[^"@]*@(?![0-9a-f]{40}")
           | (?i:docker)://(?![^"@]*@sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}")
           | [^"\\]*(?:\\|$) )
      | '(?: (?!(?i:docker)://|\./)(?:[^'@]|'')*@(?![0-9a-f]{40}'(?!'))
           | (?i:docker)://(?!(?:[^'@]|'')*@sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}'(?!'))
           | (?:[^']|'')*$ )
      | (?![\s"'*|>&!])
        (?: (?!(?i:docker)://|\./|\.\\)(?:[^\s@:]|:(?!\s|$)|\s+(?=[^\s\#]))*@
              (?![0-9a-f]{40}[,\]}]*(?:\s|$))
          | [A-Za-z0-9-]+/[^\s@:]*\s*(?:\#.*)?$
          | (?i:docker)://(?![^\s@]*@sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}[,\]}]*(?:\s|$)) )
      | \* )
  | (?:[&!]\S*(?:\s+|$))*(?:[|>][^\s\#]*\s*)?(?:\#.*)?$ )
# 2. a plain SHA followed by , ] or } on a line with no flow collection before the key: in
#    block context those characters are part of the ref, so it names a tag, not a commit
| ^[^{\[]*?(?<![^\s\[{,])(?:use[s][ \t]*:|"use[s]"\s*:|'use[s]'\s*:)\s+(?:[&!]\S*\s+)*
  (?![\s"'*&!]|(?i:docker)://|\./)(?:[^\s@:]|:(?!\s|$)|\s+(?=[^\s\#]))*@[0-9a-f]{40}[,\]}]
# 3. an image key with a docker:// image and no digest, an escape or open quote, an alias, or
#    nothing on this line
| (?<![^\s\[{,])(?:imag[e][ \t]*:(?=\s|$)|"imag[e]"\s*:|'imag[e]'\s*:)\s*
  (?: (?:[&!]\S*\s+)*
      (?: "(?: (?i:docker)://(?![^"@]*@sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}") | [^"\\]*(?:\\|$) )
        | '(?: (?i:docker)://(?!(?:[^'@]|'')*@sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}'(?!')) | (?:[^']|'')*$ )
        | (?![\s"'])(?i:docker)://(?![^\s@]*@sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}[,\]}]*(?:\s|$))
        | \* )
    | (?:[&!]\S*(?:\s+|$))*(?:[|>][^\s\#]*\s*)?(?:\#.*)?$ )
# 4. an explicit (?) key, which may span lines; a double-quoted key with an escape
| ^\s*(?:-\s+)*\?(?:\s|$)
| (?:^\s*(?:-\s+)*|[{,]\s*)"[^"\\]*\\[^"]*"\s*:
